evidence.name: Screen field: Text size
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Text size" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Text size
sections.description: Sets the font size in points, where bigger means more prominent. As a guide, about 24 to 40 works for a headline and 14 to 18 for body copy, keeping a clear hierarchy. This overrides your theme's default size for this text, so change it only when this section needs to stand apart from the rest.
